# Community results

<!-- Generated by tools/build_tables.py from data/community/*.json. Do not edit by hand: add a JSON file instead. -->

Numbers from real Intel GPUs, measured with `llama-bench` using one command: [bench/arc-bench.ps1](../bench/arc-bench.ps1) (Windows) or [bench/arc-bench.sh](../bench/arc-bench.sh) (Linux). Each result is a small JSON file in [data/community/](../data/community/) that follows [schema.json](../data/community/schema.json).

**Add your card:** run the script, then [open a benchmark issue](https://github.com/edagher92-coder/arc-llm-lab/issues/new?template=benchmark.yml) and paste the JSON, or send a pull request that adds it to `data/community/`. The raw `llama-bench` output is required, because a number without a log can't be checked. See [GOOD-FIRST-ISSUES.md](GOOD-FIRST-ISSUES.md) for cards and setups we most want to see.

All figures are tokens per second from `llama-bench` (`pp` is prompt processing, `tg` is token generation), at the context depths shown. They measure the engine without speculative decoding, so they are directly comparable between cards. Results are self-reported unless the notes say otherwise.

| GPU | VRAM | Backend / build | Patches | Model | Depths | pp (tok/s) | tg (tok/s) | Driver / OS | By | Raw |

pp is prompt processing of a 2048-token prompt and tg is generation of 32 tokens, both at the stated depth.

## Notes

- **Intel Arc Pro B60 24GB, Vulkan b11524 (86a283532) (2026-10-10):** Maintainer's own run (bench/compare-f16.ps1): stock upstream llama.cpp b11524, built with Clang 20.1.8, same card and model as the Intel FA entry. One run per cell.
- **Intel Arc Pro B60 24GB, Vulkan b11526 (c85e6c598) (2026-10-10):** Maintainer's own run (bench/compare-f16.ps1). llama.cpp b11524 plus the two Intel FA prefill patches in engine/patches, built with MinGW GNU 16.2.0. No speculative decoding in llama-bench; with the DFlash2 drafter (n=7) generation is 42.3 tok/s eval-suite throughput (wall-clock, prompt processing included; per-request decode 47-58 tok/s, mean 53.3; data/raw/tune.txt). One run per cell. The extra pp8 test in the raw log is not recorded here.

How these compare with other people's B60 numbers: [PEERS.md](PEERS.md).
